items.message: Positive control asserts counts but not values, so it can pass with the wrong lenses.

`_step()` is called twice in `_aspects_run()` but this is a latent issue; the more immediate gap is that `_step()` has no test of its own selector and silently raises `StopIteration` if the step name changes.
`test_the_lenses_share_one_tape_so_the_harvest_sees_them_all` asserts `run.count('--cassette') == 1` but this would also pass if `--cassette` appeared zero times.
No test covers the behaviour that `exit $status` reflects the worst status rather than the last one. The test checks the string is present but cannot verify the shell arithmetic is correct.
